product_summary: Manufacturer of pharmaceutical / food / cosmetic processing and packaging machinery, established 1980, plant at Plot 101A, Charkop Industrial Estate, Kandivli (West), Mumbai 400067 (source: anchormark.com home page and contact block). Real product lines per own catalogue: (1) Liquid Packaging Equipment - automatic rotary liquid filling/capping/sealing machine ROTOFILL, linear LINOFILL, automatic torque-based cap sealing machine, unscrambler, automatic airjet bottle cleaning machine, automatic rotary bottle washing machine, turntable, empty/filled bottle inspection unit, automatic dosage cup placing and pressing machine, cap/cup loading and elevator unit, automatic sticker labelling machine (source: anchormark.com/products/liquid-packaging-equipment/). (2) Powder Packaging Equipment - automatic rotary powder filling machine, automatic linear dry powder filling machine, automatic cap sealing machine, rotary cap sealing machine (pick and place), dry powder filling + cap sealing monoblock, air jet bottle cleaning machine, line accessories (source: site navigation). (3) Counting & Filling Equipment - multi-channel counting and filling machine, disc-type counting and filling machine, automatic desiccant inserter, automatic cotton inserter, semi-automatic counting and filling (source: site navigation). (4) Encapsulation Equipment - automatic, semi-automatic and manual capsule filling lines (source: site navigation). (5) Granulation Equipment - high shear mixer granulator RAPIDMIX, fluid bed dryer/processor FLUIDRY, lifting and positioning unit, lifting and tippering unit, powder transfer system, conta/octagonal/double cone/drum/V-cone blenders, vibro sifter, mechanical sifter, multimill, conemill, starch paste kettle (source: anchormark.com/products/granulation-equipment/). (6) Tablet Coating Equipment - automatic tablet coating machine 'Anchor Coater', coating pans. (7) Other Equipment - liquid manufacturing plant, ointment manufacturing plant. (8) R&D and isolator-compatible versions of the above lines.
comment: Declared codes 842230 (machinery for filling/closing/capsuling bottles and similar containers), 842290 (parts of 8422 machinery), 847982 (mixing/kneading/crushing machines) and 847990 (parts of 8479 machines) are all corroborated by the catalogue: ROTOFILL/LINOFILL filling-capping-sealing lines and the powder filling/cap-sealing monoblock map to 842230; line accessories and change parts to 842290; RAPIDMIX high shear mixer granulator, blenders, sifters, multimill, conemill and powder transfer system to 847982; parts of those to 847990. Status: partial, not exact, because several real product lines are missing from the declaration: (a) capsule filling lines (automatic/semi-automatic/manual) - these are encapsulating machinery, normally 8479.89 (or 8422.30 depending on the customs line used for capsule fillers), not covered by the four declared codes; (b) fluid bed dryer/processor FLUIDRY and tablet coating machines 'Anchor Coater'/coating pans - drying and coating apparatus, normally 8419.39 / 8479.89, absent from the declaration; (c) automatic sticker labelling machine - labelling machinery, normally 8422.30 or 8422.40, absent; (d) liquid and ointment manufacturing plants - mixing/processing plant, normally 8479.82/8479.89, absent; (e) bottle washing/cleaning machines and unscramblers - normally 8422.20/8422.30, absent. Recommended additions to the declaration: 847989 (capsule fillers, FBD, coating, plants), 842240 (labelling where applicable), and 842220 (bottle washing) if those lines are shipped. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: the company is a pharmaceutical/GMP machinery builder whose food and beverage exposure is only as an end-use vertical of its packaging lines; the correct industry is industrial machinery / pharmaceutical equipment manufacturing. No trader signs found - own manufacturing address, own brand names (ROTOFILL, LINOFILL, RAPIDMIX, FLUIDRY, Anchor Coater) and own engineering content. All product claims above are from the company's own website catalogue only; no customs line was available in this task, so the specific HS-6 mapping of each machine is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until matched against actual shipping bills. HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - company retained, codes to be corrected/extended.
